## ⚡ Where Does the Funding Go?

- **Hardware Testing & Telemetry Rig:** Acquiring varied GPU hardware (NVIDIA RTX, AMD Radeon, APUs, DisplayLink) to ensure zero-bug performance across all drivers.
- **Wayland & Qt6 Optimization:** Funding time spent refactoring QML spring physics engines and DBus IPC integrations.
- **Cloud Infrastructure:** Hosting build-test nodes and continuous integration (CI/CD) packaging for CachyOS/Arch Linux.
